/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff --check && git diff && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts && git commit -m "feat(transport): validate conversation list frames" && git push origin HEAD'
